versions.changelog:
- Improved documentation to explain how to discover, connect, and browse the Bitroad marketplace over MCP.
- Detailed guidance on spending caps, confirmation thresholds, and the checkout flow.
- Clearer error handling instructions, including differences between cap refusals and confirmation requests.
- Expanded sections outlining services (goods vs. paid work), returns, and disputes processes.
- New instructions on using seller trust metrics and checking restricted goods before purchasing.
